description:
Show a month's prices and booking rules as an interactive card in the chat.

Use instead of get_rates when the guest wants to see the overview; each apartment line can be tapped to
check its dates. Use get_rates when only the data is needed. Same arguments, behaviour (read-only, live)
and result as get_rates.

children.description: Ages of ALL children 0-17, comma-separated, e.g. '8,15'; empty if none. Ages change price and tourist tax (charged from age 17).
children.title: Children

guests.description: Deprecated alias of adults (clients before 2.2.0); 0 = unused
guests.title: Guests

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

name: render_rates_card

apartments.description: Per apartment: nr, name, lowest total EUR, nights, check_in/check_out of that reference stay

periods.description: Booking rules: from, to, closed, min_nights, arrival_weekdays

weeks.description: Searched reference stays with all prices
